published.source: DPS report 2026-10-31 (wowsimcli on this request, 20,000 iterations, seed 1, 180 ± 20 s; re-simmed on 2026-10-30 or 2026-10-31)

summary: Keeps Judgement of the Crusader on the boss for the raid.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Righteousness at -4.5s, Light's Vigil at -3s, Seal of the Crusader at -1.5s
Hammer of Wrath under 20% boss health, before everything else
Judgement of the Crusader at the pull, for the duty. It adds 161 Holy damage taken for 40s. The paladin's melee hits refresh it, so one cast lasts the fight. Judge it again only if it drops
Seal of Righteousness whenever it's down, before Consecration. So it goes right after the opening Judgement of the Crusader
Consecration on cooldown at any mana
Judgement on cooldown on Seal of Righteousness. Recast Seal of Righteousness whenever it's down (no twisting)
Light's Vigil when it's not on the target, at 30%+ mana, and the next swing is over 2.5s away (its cast resets the swing)

Holy Shock on a target with Light's Vigil. It detonates the Vigil, refunds 75% of its mana and starts no cooldown. When the Vigil is held back (low mana, or a swing within 2.5s), Holy Shock on cooldown. Divine Favor goes on a Holy Shock
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Major Mana Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Takes Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed), a must-have talent. It costs 1.6 / 1.9 / 2.1 DPS at 120 / 180 / 300s.
Uses Libram of Fervor (+33 to Judgement of the Crusader). At 180s it beats Libram of Law by 5.9 DPS on twist duty and 7.7 on Shock duty.
Runs short of mana. It's 7.4% behind Ret twist at 120s, 8.2% at 180s and 9.8% at 300s.
Divine Precision's hit doesn't cover Judgement of Righteousness.
A missed Holy Shock wastes the Vigil. Holy spells miss about 1% of the time.
Unverified: Holy Strike's flat bonus is added before its weapon damage percent, as the client data says.
The top Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% of DPS).

Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power per hit with a two-hander, counted once, as its tooltip says (spell 70425). Counted twice, DPS would be 46-51 higher. At the proc spell's 0%, it would be 53-59 lower.
No filler explosive, because each 1s cast resets the swing. The Goblin Land Mine and EZ-Thro Dark Bomb cost 5.4 DPS at 180s, and the EZ-Thro Thorium Grenade 6.1.
notes: Request: paladin__level_60_shock with raid debuff judgementOfTheCrusader removed and the level60_shock_crusader_duty rotation. Undead since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Human (follows its base build, paladin__level_60_shock).
